digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and registry; documentation and agent skills
propositions: rebar metrics command and registry exist but are not consulted by rebar-janitor or discoverable in project docs

rebar-janitor Discovery phase should invoke `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` to cite code-health trend evidence (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor ratio, cap-change events) alongside one-shot analysis tools

docs/user-guide.md must document the rebar metrics command, the four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state to make metrics findable by humans
docs/reuse-surface.md must reference the rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative) so library consumers can reuse it
AGENTS.md where-to-read list must include a metrics pointer to user-guide.md and reuse-surface.md
